description: Klark: agents, panes, messages and feeds (needs klark on PATH)

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Is a klark server running, and which version

commands.name: agents
commands.summary: List agents in every klark session

commands.name: read
commands.summary: Read an agent's recent terminal output

commands.name: prompt
commands.summary: Submit a prompt to an agent
examples: aos klark prompt rev "run the tests"

commands.name: wait
commands.summary: Wait until an agent reaches a state (idle, done, blocked...)

commands.name: send
commands.summary: Type literal text into a pane (no Enter)

commands.name: msg
commands.summary: Send a klark message to another agent
examples: aos klark msg work/rev "PR is ready"

commands.name: feed
commands.summary: Add a feed: send new output of a command, file or poll to an agent
examples: aos klark feed work/rev "Look at new errors" --follow app.log

commands.name: stats
commands.summary: Memory and CPU of the klark server and each agent pane

commands.name: hub
commands.summary: Hub connection status of this machine
